tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground under the cards and the bottom of the hero band. Ink on bg: 15.3:1.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the + menu. Floats over bg with shadow-card. Text on it: ink 13.6:1, muted 6.7:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text, spent money (solid meter fill), the over-pace pill fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Cyan. Actions and live state: primary and pill buttons, the + button, active tab, pace line, planned-spend hatching, pending and itemized marks, focus rings. 9.8:1 on paper; paper text on accent 9.8:1.

tokens.name: money
tokens.usage: Lime. Yen amounts only: the amount left, row amounts, totals. 12.5:1 on paper. Never on buttons or decoration.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, dates, meta lines, inactive tabs. Ink 66% into paper. 6.7:1 on paper, 7.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside cards, input and chip borders. Ink 16% into paper. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: received/pending boxes, the net line, input fields. Ink 9% into paper. Muted on it: 5.2:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected wishlist rows, the dark stripe in hatching, the match box. Accent 12% into paper. Accent text on it: 7.5:1.

families.sans: Manrope, "Zen Kaku Gothic New", system-ui, -apple-system, "Hiragino Sans", sans-serif

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: The one number per screen: what is left to spend. In money. Tabular figures.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Row amounts, per-day figure, totals. In money, right-aligned in lists.

styles.name: amount-sm
styles.usage: Dates, split lines, meter scale. In muted.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Source and card tags on charges.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: The month, centered in the hero band. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sheet titles, the month in the sticky bar.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Section tabs under the hero. Active: accent with a 2px accent underline.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a row, hints, leads in sheets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between tags; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rows of a list, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cards on the page; inside list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above the meter for the pace label.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top padding of the hero band.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and status chips on charges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, wells, inputs, selects, the + menu.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter chips, pills, the meter, the toast. The + button is a full circle.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the + menu, lifting paper off bg. No borders on cards.

tokens.name: shadow-echo-pill
tokens.usage: Two fading accent circles trailing the hero's Add pill.

tokens.name: shadow-echo-fab
tokens.usage: The same echo leading the round + button.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target: chips, tabs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Inputs and buttons in sheets.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Payback and wishlist rows.

tokens.name: fab
tokens.usage: The round + button, bottom right.

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: Max content width; wider screens center one phone-width column.
